summary: Iter115 — End-to-end verification of the 4 new items: (1) Align lock + unlink + redaction, (2) Safety mediator include_answers, (3) /what-professionals-see Attorney-review switch + Align card copy, (4) Goal celebration banner once per goal. Backend: 15/15 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_iter115_align_lock_and_mediator.py. Direct DB audit of mediator_emails confirms included_answers:true/false recorded correctly. Frontend: Account /account Align card (link/unlink flow verified at 1920 + 390). Safety mediator dialog on /safety-assessment results confirmed: checkbox unchecked by default, hint 'Left out...' when unchecked and 'Your mediator will see your Section 1 safety answers and Section 2 readiness answers.' when checked; captured POST /api/safety-assessment/{id}/email-mediator payload with include_answers:false (parent2 after fresh submission). Goal celebration verified for journey6: banner door-self-goal-reached shows after marking goal reached in SA Progress tab + closing SA (API shortcut used since picture-spot click didn't open SA view in headless portal flow); banner text contains goal '"Pause before replying" · Oct 10, 2026. Your child feels this progress too.'; dismiss works; localStorage key sac_goal_celebrated_<uid> populated with the entry_id (observed twice — see note); reload does NOT re-show the banner for that goal. /what-professionals-see: pros-see-draft-label present with 'Draft, pending attorney review' copy; pros-see-method-align card contains both new sentences 'You can unlink at any time from your Account page...' and 'If your safety results show a concern, Align only sees which sections are finished and the dates, not your answers or anything you wrote.'; #safety-check section mentions 'your answers are left out unless you choose to include them.' Attorney review badge still showing (ATTORNEY_REVIEW_PENDING=true). CLEANUP: parent1 LEFT linked, parent2 LEFT unlinked, journey6 goal un-marked and localStorage key cleared.
critical_code_review_comments: integration_routes.py _redact_for_safety on L459-460 relies on `foundation['canonical']` existing — if the export is ever changed to omit `canonical` the function throws KeyError. Add .get('canonical', {}) guard for defensive coding.

GoalReachedBanner stores an array of celebrated goal ids and .slice(-100). Observed in test: when a dismiss happens, the entry id was appended twice ('["6947b35b...","6947b35b..."]') — likely because both the banner mount effect AND the dismiss handler call setSeen with the same id. Not functionally harmful (array dedupe at compare time by .includes) but it does mean the 100-slot ring fills twice as fast per goal. Dedupe before writing: `[...new Set([...readSeen(userId), pending.id])].slice(-100)`.

Confetti canvas was gone by the time the test queried for 'canvas' selectors (~5s after banner mount). If the UX intent is a *brief* burst that's fine; if a confetti check must be deterministic for automation, consider leaving a transparent canvas element in the DOM for 1-2 seconds longer, or wire a data-testid='door-self-goal-reached-confetti' on the canvas while active.

safety_assessment_routes.py email_assessment_to_mediator correctly records included_answers alongside sent_at/to/name — nice. Consider also stamping request IP + a short rate limit (currently any logged-in parent can push many emails to delivered@resend.dev / arbitrary mediators).
test_credentials: parent1@test.com / parent2@test.com / journey6@test.com, password TestPass123!. INTEGRATION_SHARED_SECRET read from /app/backend/.env (not printed). Auth cookie is httpOnly (fetch /api/auth/login with credentials:'include' from the browser context — JWT in Authorization header is NOT what the SPA uses).
seed_data_creation: None persistent. parent2 was linked and unlinked (ends unlinked, as requested). parent1 remained linked throughout (as requested). parent2 completed a fresh safety-assessment (sa_cbe4908ba41f) with all-'no' answers in order to reach the results card and exercise the mediator dialog; this created 3 mediator_emails entries pointing to delivered@resend.dev (test mailbox). journey6 goal '6947b35b-378d-43f3-ba0d-843f6f136cee' ("Pause before replying") was marked reached and then un-marked; localStorage key sac_goal_celebrated_<uid> was cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via httpOnly cookie (fetch /api/auth/login with credentials:'include' inside the browser context). The frontend state keeps a module variable, not localStorage, so dropping Bearer tokens in storage won't make the Account page show the real user. /safety-assessment never auto-jumps to the results view on page load — it only renders results right after a fresh UI submit (SelfAssessment.jsx L143 setStep(6)); to reach the mediator dialog you must drive a full submission. Section-1 and Section-2 questions are implemented as Yes/No/Unsure *buttons* now, not radio inputs — click `button` elements by text. SelfAssessmentView opens from inside the portal's Self Journey as a full-page overlay (JourneyShell L1122). Clicking data-testid='door-self-art-assess' invokes onAction via JourneyArtCard but in a headless browser the overlay sometimes doesn't mount visibly; use the API path /api/self-assessment/goal/reached with entry_id to drive the backend state and then just revisit /portal → door-self to see the banner. SA history API returns {entries, current_goal, goal_practice} (not an array). Mediator email endpoint accepts include_answers (default False) and records included_answers on the mediator_emails push.
